parse_show_collation: parse a MySQL SHOW COLLATION dump file into a sorted pandas DataFrame
render_collations_header: render a C++ header string from a collation DataFrame for mysql or mariadb
write_headers: write generated mysql and mariadb collation C++ header files to the include directory
invoke_file_headers: invoke the file_headers.py script to set copyright headers on generated files
main: run the full collation header generation pipeline from MySQL and MariaDB dump files
